title: Add a class to a group

steps.say: **Add a class** builds a class underneath the group you are standing on, before anybody is teaching it. Tapping it opens the form and creates nothing.
The class name goes here, and the course beside it is what the class will learn. Both are needed before the button will do anything.
**Add** creates it. A class needs no teacher to exist — it sits under the group waiting, and you put a teacher on it from your staff list whenever you are ready.
steps.terminal: That's a class set up in advance, teacher to follow. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
